About Organization

Union Bank of India is a government-owned bank in India. The bank was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

The bank has a wide range of products and services, including personal banking, corporate banking, and investment banking.

About the Programme

The Union Bank of India UBI Apprentices Recruitment 2026 is a government jobs recruitment program. The program is open for 1865 posts and is available for candidates who have a bachelor's degree in any stream.

The program aims to provide opportunities for young and talented individuals to join the banking sector and contribute to the growth and development of the country.
